candidateAudit.text: TUTTE LE INFO ⬇️📌 A Vienna la colazione perfetta non esist… o forse sì? 👀🥞 Se anche tu davanti a una colazione non sai mai scegliere tra dolce e salato, questo posto potrebbe metterti seriamente in difficoltà 😂🤤 Vuoi sapere dove si trova? Te lo svelo qui sotto 👇📌 🥞 Sto parlando di Japanese Pancake Vienna, in pieno centro, dove puoi trovare i famosi Japanese Soufflé Pancakes: altissimi, morbidissimi e così soffici che sembrano quasi delle nuvole. Puoi sceglierli in versione dolce o salata e, ve lo dico, oltre a essere super scenografici sono davvero golosi, ma allo stesso tempo sorprendentemente leggeri e sazianti 😍 🍳 E se invece hai voglia di qualcosa di diverso, il menu è pieno di alternative: bagel con salmone, English Breakfast, croissant con bacon, sandwich e tante altre proposte per una colazione o un brunch sostanzioso ma al contempo leggero! 💡Perfetto anche per chi non tollera o ha allergie al glutine! C’è l’imbarazzo della scelta 😍 📌 INFO UTILI 📍 Drahtgasse 2, 1010 Wien 🕐 Lun–Gio: 9:30–20:00 🕐 Ven–Dom: 9:30–21:00 Insomma, se sei a Vienna e cerchi un posto per una colazione diversa dal solito, questo posto fa al caso tuo! 📌 Salva il Reel per la tua prossima colazione/brunch a Vienna! 🤤 👉 Segui tuttoilmondoepaese_blog per altri indirizzi food, posti insoliti e consigli da insider per scoprire Vienna oltre i soliti itinerari 🇦🇹 #vienna #viennafood #austria #wien #viennablogger

candidateAudit.text: Our food tour guides at Tipsy Bites Tours don’t stop eating when the tour ends. 😏 If anything, their days off are just another excuse to go looking for good food. Last weekend, we headed to volksstimmefest - one of Vienna’s big open-air festivals, with food, music, culture and plenty of reasons to stay hungry. And, naturally, we spent a good part of our day following the smoke from grills. 🔥 What we love most about events like this is getting to discover flavours and food traditions from all over the world - right here in Vienna. Because our guides aren’t just foodies when they’re working. They’re curious eaters all the time.Volksstimmefest 2026 may be over, but there’s always another food adventure around the corner. Want to know which food events are coming up in Vienna? Follow us - we’ll see you there! tipsybitestours.com #vienna #viennafood #viennaevent #foodie #viennaguide

candidateAudit.text: 🇦🇹 Wie könnte eine Rapid-Kollektion aussehen, wenn jedes Trikot ein Stück Vereinsgeschichte erzählt? Vier Konzepte. Vier verschiedene Kapitel einer Identität. Jedes Trikot verbindet Vergangenheit und Gegenwart auf seine eigene Art. Welches würdet ihr tragen? 👀 1️⃣ Home 2️⃣ Away 3️⃣ Third 4️⃣ Fourth Schreibt eure Nummer in die Kommentare. 👇 🇬🇧 What would a Rapid collection look like if every kit told a part of the club’s history? Wiener Arbeiter-Fußball-Club in 1897 to Rapid’s iconic green and white tradition, the historic Vienna skyline and the influence of Viennese Art Nouveau. Each kit connects the club’s past with a modern identity in its own way. candidateAudit.title: I’m overseas this Labor Day but still had plenty of encased meats to consume in Vienna. Quick layover so I was only able to check out a few spots but the one thing I had to do was
candidateAudit.text: I’m overseas this Labor Day but still had plenty of encased meats to consume in Vienna. Quick layover so I was only able to check out a few spots but the one thing I had to do was try the Käsekrainer which is a Brühwurst made up of pork and beef with bits of Emmental cheese. I went to one of the city’s popular sausage kiosks called Würstelstand zum Hohen Markt and ordered it sliced as opposed to a bun. I think that was the snappiest piece of sausage I’ve consumed. Next up was the iconic Trzesniewski for Brötchen which is the Austrian term for Smørrebrød. I really liked how they pour mini glasses of beer to go with the mini open faced sandwiches first popularized in Denmark. (3-4) Last stop was one of the worlds most famous sausage stands at Bitzinger for a Bosna - thin brats in a toasted bun with raw onion, fresh parsley, mustard and a nice dusting of curry powder and cayenne pepper - killer. #ViennaFood 🇦🇹

candidateAudit.title: Eine Zeitreise ins Wien von 1912 🎥 Diese seltenen Originalaufnahmen zeigen den Karlsplatz in einer Ära, in der die Moderne gerade erst Einzug hielt. Im Zentrum steht der prachtvol
candidateAudit.text: Eine Zeitreise ins Wien von 1912 🎥 Diese seltenen Originalaufnahmen zeigen den Karlsplatz in einer Ära, in der die Moderne gerade erst Einzug hielt. Im Zentrum steht der prachtvolle Eingang zur Hoch- und Untergrundbahn, ein architektonisches Meisterwerk von Otto Wagner aus dem Jahr 1899. Während die glänzenden Strukturen der Stadtbahn den Fortschritt der Jahrhundertwende verkünden, gleiten im Hintergrund noch die traditionellen Fiaker lautlos über das Kopfsteinpflaster. Die majestätische Kulisse der Karlskirche rahmt diese Szene ein und lässt den Betrachter die geschäftige Atmosphäre des alten Wien spüren 🏛️. Es ist ein faszinierender Kontrast zwischen der aufkommenden Industrialisierung und der klassischen Eleganz der k.u.k. Monarchie 🇦🇹. Solche Filme sind heute die einzigen Fenster in eine Welt, die kurz vor ihrem totalen Umbruch stand. Die Wiener Stadtbahn war damals schon viel effizienter als das heutige Chaos am Gürtel, oder was meint ihr? #Wien #Vienna #Karlsplatz #OttoWagner #Jugendstil #WienGeschichte #Austria #VisitVienna #Architektur #Historisch #Stadtbahn #Kultur #Österreich #VintageWien #FinDeSiècle

candidateAudit.title: 1️⃣Don’t trust your process Every 20–30 minutes, our teachers would make us step away from our work and look at it from a distance. Up close, you get lost in details and stop seein
candidateAudit.text: 1️⃣Don’t trust your process Every 20–30 minutes, our teachers would make us step away from our work and look at it from a distance. Up close, you get lost in details and stop seeing the whole picture. We were also encouraged to look at how other students approached the same task and learn from their solutions. It taught me not to copy someone’s solution, but to analyze it, question my own decisions, and look for better ways to achieve the result I want. 2️⃣Never fall in love with your painting At any moment, your teacher could take your watercolor to the sink and wash away half of it with tap water. It taught me that sometimes there’s nothing to save. Let it go, start over, and make it better. 3️⃣Never erase the wrong line We were taught to keep our wrong lines and draw over them until we found the one that actually felt right. It taught me to trust my eye, not my eraser. 4️⃣Don’t underestimate the apple Another day, another still life. The same apple, the same drapery, the same setup I’d already drawn approximately 847 times. It taught me to find new approaches to even the most ordinary subjects. 5️⃣Never think in 2D If you want to understand 3D, sculpt it. We’d make eyes, noses, and lips out of clay before drawing them on paper. It taught me to feel volume instead of just copying what I see. #art #illustration #digitalart #vienna artist

candidateAudit.text: CARBONARA. ABER ANDERS. Vergiss alles, was du über Carbonara zu wissen glaubst. Bei uns gibt es keine Carbonara von der Stange – sondern unsere eigene Interpretation: cremig, unwiderstehlich und mit Liebe gemacht. candidateAudit.text: ⬇️How to use the Rax Seilbahn!⬇️ 🎫 A ride costs €38 round trip for adults, and you’re definitely going to want to book your tickets online in advance! If you have a Niederösterreich Card you get one round trip ride included! You do still need to claim your ticket online though. 🚗 How to get to the Rax: With public transport - take the train from Wien Meidling to Payerbach-Reichenau and then a short bus ride to the cable car! It’ll take you a little under two hours. With a car it’ll you around and hour and a half! What do you like to get up to on the Rax? candidateAudit.text: A can‘t miss day trip from Vienna, filled with apricots, wine and gorgeous train rides along the Danube! 📍Wachau Valley visitniederoesterreich 🚂 First, take an unsereoebb train to Krems an der Donau! 🚞 Then it‘s time to hop on to the Wachaubahn! It takes you up and down the valley, from Krems to Emmersdorf. A hop-on-hop-off ticket will cost you €21 and allows you to make as many trips stops in whatever direction you want for an entire day! 🎫 If you have a niederoesterreich.card (and you should!) you get one hop-on-hop-off ticket included - that‘s what I used to film this trip! I‘m gonna share more content about what I ate in the Wachau and where I went, so make sure to give me a follow so you don‘t miss it! & if you have any tips on what to eat in the Wachau or what to do in the Wachau, please send them my way! 🙏 #niederösterreich #austriatravel #viennatravel #viennaaustria #wachau
